question: What dark-colored essence is accessed by resorting to the place of the yoginī?
premises: One resorts to the place of the yoginī
It is dark and black in color
inference: By resorting to the place of the yoginī, one accesses the dark, black-colored essence.
plain_english: Having resorted to the place of the yoginī, one finds that which is dark and black in color.
